invariants.rationale: stream() is called on 'data', so it must not be null at entry.
'func' is wrapped and passed as a mapping function, so it cannot be null.
Parallelism is intended to specify the level of concurrency, so it is natural to expect a positive value.
size() on any List is always non-negative.
Parallelism is typically at most the dataset size, except for empty lists.
